notes.title: Our First Playtest is Complete – Thank You, Everyone!
notes.notes: [p]Hello Abbesses and Abbots,[/p][p]Our very first public playtest has officially come to an end, and we couldn’t be happier with the results. A huge [b]thank you[/b] to everyone who joined, played, and shared feedback with us!🙏[/p][p]📊 Here’s a look at the playtest in numbers:[/p][list][*][p][b]380+ players[/b] joined the playtest.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Our most dedicated testers logged [b]200+ minutes of gameplay[/b] (some couldn’t stop playing 😅)[/p][/*][*][p]The game received an [b]average rating of 4/5[/b]—a strong start, with plenty of room to grow.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]20+ feature requests[/b] were submitted, many of which are already in our backlog[/p][/*][/list][p]💡 Some of your most-requested ideas included:[/p][list][*][p]Automating dirt cleaning 🧹[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusting balance—currently it’s a little too easy to make money (our generous worshippers make big donations!).[/p][/*][*][p]Expanding ties with the local community through events, requests, and more.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]What’s next?[/b][/h3][p]Over the coming months, we’ll be focusing on:[/p][list][*][p]Refining balance and progression[/p][/*][*][p]Improving tutorials for a smoother onboarding[/p][/*][*][p]Adding quality-of-life improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Developing exciting new features 👀[/p][/*][/list][p]Once again, thank you for your incredible support. Keep following our journey—and if you haven’t already, don’t forget to [b]add us to your Steam wishlist[/b] to stay updated on the next big milestones![/p][p]Dragonkin Studios[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544135/87dee5814c480757062319dde6c84a274b5f2c55.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Open Playtest is live!

[/p][/*][*][p]Produce goods like wheat, honey, manuscripts and beer.[/p][/*][*][p]Build up your monastery’s economy and meet the community's requests.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]🛠️ How to Join the Playtest[/h3][p]For information on how to join the playtest, follow the instructions in our previous article:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3179120/announcements/detail/510715359276302515"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Open Playtest Starts August 29
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544135/4d4d1781d6a5e6512c997ea71ccae353acf51644.png"][/img][/p][p]Dear Abbots and Abbesses,[/p][p]We are excited to announce that the [b]first public playtest for [i]Monastery: Ora et Labora[/i][/b] is almost here!
Starting today, you can [b]request access directly on our Steam page[/b] using the green [i]“Request Access”[/i] button. Access will be granted in [b]one week[/b], so make sure to sign up early![/p][p][/p][h3]🛠️ How to Join the Playtest[/h3][olist][*][p]Head over to our steam page[/p][/*][*][p]Click the [b]“Request Access”[/b] button under the Playtest section.[/p][/*][*][p]Wait until we approve access (in about a week).[/p][/*][*][p]Once approved, you’ll be able to download and play the test build![/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][h3]💬 How to Share Feedback[/h3][p]Your thoughts are vital in shaping the monastery’s future! After playing, you can:[/p][list][*][p]Post in the [b]Playtest Feedback section[/b] of our Steam Community.[/p][/*][*][p]Join our [url="https://discord.gg/U5zRhCuWRC"]Discord Community[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Fill out our playtest feedback form (the link is within the game)[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🙏 Wishlist & Support[/h3][p]If you enjoy what you play, the best way to support us is to:[/p][list][*][p][b]Wishlist [i]Monastery: Ora et Labora[/i][/b] on Steam – it really helps spread the word.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Share the playtest with friends[/b] who enjoy strategy/management games.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Join our Discord[/b] to be part of our growing community of faithful testers![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]❓ FAQ[/h3][p][b]Q: When will the playtest start?[/b][/p][p][b]A[/b]: You can request access now. Access will be granted in [b]one week[/b].[/p][p][b]Q: How long will the playtest last?[/b][/p][p][b]A:[/b] We’ll keep it open for a limited time (details will be shared once it starts).[/p][p][b]Q: Is progress saved?[/b][/p][p][b]A[/b]: Progress will not carry over to the final release, but you’re free to play as much as you like during the test.[/p][p][b]Q[/b]: [b]What languages are available in the playtest?[/b][/p][p][b]A[/b]: During the playtest, only [b]English[/b] and [b]Italian[/b] will be available. The final release of the game will also include: German, French, Spanish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese.[/p][p][b]Q[/b]: [b]Can I stream or make a video based on this build?[/b][/p][p][b]A[/b]: Of course, you are free to stream or make videos about the game, but please mention that it is a playtest version and still a work in progress. Feel free to tag us on social media, we would be happy to share your work![/p][p][b]Q:[/b] [b]Is this playtest build representative of the final version?[/b][/p][p][b]A[/b]: This playtest is an early look at [b][i]Monastery: Ora et Labora[/i][/b]. While it already contains the core gameplay, it’s not fully representative of the final game. Some features, balance, and content will evolve as we continue development. One of the main goals of this playtest is to gather your [b]feedback[/b], so your experience and suggestions can directly help shape the final version.[/p][p][b]Q: Will there be controller support?[/b][/p][p][b]A[/b]: Currently, the playtest supports keyboard and mouse only. Controller support may be added later.[/p][hr][/hr][p]We can’t wait to welcome you inside the monastery walls.[/p][p]Thank you for helping us shape the future of [b][i]Monastery: Ora et Labora[/i][/b]![/p][p][b]Dragonkin Studios Team[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544135/87dee5814c480757062319dde6c84a274b5f2c55.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Monastery: Ora et Labora | Announced
notes.notes:
Dragonkin Studios is excited to announce its newest title, Monastery: Ora et Labora, a monastery management game that puts you in the role of an abbot tasked with guiding a monastic community through the trials and triumphs of medieval life.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3179120/Monastery_Ora_et_Labora/

Lead your monks in prayer and labor to build a thriving medieval monastery. Manage resources, brew ale, craft manuscripts, and face trials like war and weather. Customize, expand, and guide your brotherhood to achieve spiritual and economic prosperity.

[previewyoutube=7fJKe5x5kiU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Manage Monastery Resources[/b]: Oversee the monastery's vital resources, including food, water, herbs, and tools. Balance the production and consumption of these resources to ensure the community thrives, all while adhering to the monastic values of simplicity and self-sufficiency.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544135/e90f91942cde08c4fc7d07d94422884383ab9057.gif[/img]

[b]Build and Decorate:[/b] Expand and personalize your monastery by constructing new rooms and adding decorative elements. Each addition not only enhances the monastery's functionality but also reflects the spiritual beauty and tranquillity of monastic life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544135/d2df12de47ac70d0482a235cb90acedafa1aae41.gif[/img]

[b]Pray (Ora): [/b]Lead your monks in prayer to influence life in the monastery and the world around it. Devoted prayers can prevent bad events, bring good fortune, and create a positive atmosphere. By focusing on prayer, you can help guide the community toward peace and prosperity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544135/882df5fe434541d03807e101fc9ec42e228fd0d7.gif[/img]

[b]Work (Labora):[/b] Assign your monks to various tasks like farming, crafting, and brewing. Each monk's work helps the monastery grow and thrive. Plan their duties carefully to make the most of their skills and meet the needs of the community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544135/4088f8205ade0e60aa0540e5cf4ee076fb33096c.gif[/img]

[b]Handle Events:[/b] Face unexpected challenges and opportunities that arise from both within and outside the monastery. From harsh weather and visiting pilgrims to spiritual crises and moral dilemmas, your decisions will shape the future of your monastic community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544135/a5b4a796bbbd9a059a3514cdfb5caaf592ed54a0.gif[/img]
